title: DiffPuter: Empowering Diffusion Models for Missing Data Imputation

layout.note: A clockwise loop of small tables: the top row runs left to right (x, one-hot, mean imputation), a curved arrow enters the EM loop on the right where two tall dashed boxes (M step, E step) stand side by side, and the bottom row runs back right to left (decoded one-hot table, then x*). Each table sits under or beside a small caption; no panel frames.

lesson: Follow one small toy table through the pipeline and redraw it after every operation with only the changed cells tinted (missing as dashed boxes, filled as 'mean', imputed as colour); box the iterative part in two dashed boxes with labelled Sync arrows.
